pr_title: release-21.1: backupccl: report partial span progress
pr_body:
Backport 1/1 commits from #66654.

/cc @cockroachdb/release

---

This changes backup processor to send partial spans back instead of buffering
them until complete and lets the coordinator decide to ignore them when updating
the job progress. This allows recording more granular progress and avoids the
map of partial spans which previously saw invalid concurrent reads and writes
between backup workers.

Fixes #66626.

Release note: none.
